### Abigail Saves David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/abigail-saves-david
Passage: 1 Samuel 25:32-33
Points:
- Scripture presents biblical figures honestly, revealing David's dangerous overreaction to Nabal's insult.
- David's rush to violent vengeance demonstrated the need for a truly flawless, greater king.
- Abigail intervened with courage and generous supplies to keep David from bringing bloodguilt upon himself.
- David praised the Lord and thanked Abigail for speaking wisdom and restoring his spiritual perspective.
- Believers should thank God for His providential mercy in restraining them from carrying out sinful impulses.

### Daily Disciples Devotional - Apr. 14, 2009
Author: Daily Disciples Ministries
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-disciples/daily-disciples-devotional-apr-14-2009-11602198.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 25:32-34
Points:
- Being repaid evil for good tempts believers to react in the flesh and seek personal vengeance.
- God sovereignly directed Abigail to intercept David before he committed unnecessary bloodshed.
- David demonstrated wisdom by listening to Abigail and entrusting the injustice to God's justice.
- Believers must recognize God's sovereignty over mistreatment and leave retribution in His hands.
- Christians should pray for discernment to receive godly intervention or serve as peacemakers for others.

### How Abigail's Story in 1 Samuel 25 Reveals God's Saving Work
Author: Nana Dolce
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/abigail-point-christ/
Passage: 1 Samuel 25:18-35
Points:
- Old Testament stories provide more than moral lessons; they point forward to God's work of salvation.
- Abigail stepped out unarmed before hundreds of warriors to protect her undeserving household.
- Her humble mediation and soft answers turned David away from bloodshed and back toward worship.
- Abigail's intercession foreshadows Jesus Christ, the ultimate Mediator who took on wrath for sinners.
- Believers are reminded that Christ faced divine wrath to reconcile us to God.

### Beware the Anger of Your Soul: How to Restrain Ungodly Passion
Author: Joe Rigney
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/beware-the-anger-of-your-soul
Passage: 1 Samuel 25:21-34
Points:
- Passions such as anger can quickly become rash, leading to destructive choices if left unchecked.
- David allowed an insult to provoke impulsive fury that nearly resulted in the slaughter of Nabal's household.
- Abigail curbed David's rage by urging him to preserve a clear conscience and trust God's protection.
- Believers must rein in rising wrath by remembering that vengeance belongs only to the Lord.
- Walking by faith means responding thoughtfully rather than reacting impulsively in times of conflict.
